name: CASCADE LAKES BREWERY RM27
address: 21175 SE REED MARKET ROAD, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Residence; Solar Panel System; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Large Paved Surface; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked and clearly marked so responders can locate it without delay.
• Mark or label the detached structure on any posted site map so responders can account for it during operations.
• Post the solar panel system shutoff location and controls in a visible spot near the main electrical panel or front entry so responders can locate it quickly.
• Keep the large paved surface clear of parked vehicles along at least one full side to allow emergency vehicle staging and movement.
• Trim any landscaping that blocks sightlines to the main entry, detached structure, or access points from the street or driveway.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Open Green Space; Scattered Shrubs; Irrigated Landscape; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim any shrub branches that are touching or within a few feet of the house walls and foundation.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so their branches do not overlap or touch each other.
• Remove dead or dry material from within shrub groupings located close to the house.
• Keep the area directly around the base of the house clear of shrub and plant growth.
• Separate shrub clusters from nearby trees so there is open ground between them.
• Maintain open ground between the irrigated landscape plantings and any outbuildings or fences.
